goal: Bind all new Xeno data before cognition and compile a reusable deterministic 10-cell logical plan over shared physical workers without creating truth/effect authority.
hypothesis: A single typed ingress identity plus deterministic XPU plan compiler can serve GRID10 and later COGSIM10/WM_TEST/NESTED_SIM while eliminating route-decision causal aliasing.
counterhypothesis: The shared packet/control abstraction merely moves complexity into metadata and scheduler logic, adding latency and failure modes without improving replay/provenance safety.
discriminator: Compare deterministic replay, stale-generation rejection, causal event alias resistance, cell/inference/token budget enforcement and logical-vs-physical worker separation before adding model runtime complexity.

unusual_experiment.name: CAUSAL_ALIAS_POISON
unusual_experiment.intervention: Hold causal_id, payload reference, resource budget and requested routing functions fixed while mutating immutable event provenance; require different ingress/plan digests, then replay the exact first event and require identical digests.

fusion_updates.one_path_convergence: REMOVED independent monolithic Xeno/entry_grid10_v1.py plus its separate regression surface; retained split entry_fabric_v1.py + grid10_scheduler_v1.py + test_entry_grid_v1.py as the single current candidate path.
fusion_updates.typed_ingress_hardening: Current branch rejects bool/string numeric coercion for generation/resource budgets and rejects scalar/mapping coercion for provenance/permissions/capability collections.

authority_invariants: Xeno ingress and grid plans are candidate/control metadata only
canonical durable truth remains UnifiedDB or the current Xeno MiniUnifiedDB compatibility substrate
EffectGate+EffectJournal remain the only real effect authority
logical cell count is not physical decode concurrency
stale or future generation fails closed
typed ingress does not coerce bool/string values into numeric generation or resource-budget authority
provenance/permissions/capability collections do not accept scalar strings or mappings as implicit collections
raw payload is not stored in packet identity; only opaque/digest-backed payload_ref is admitted
plan identity commits to ingress/event identity so identical routing output cannot erase causal provenance
one canonical Entry/GRID10 source path is retained
